title: Bridging Blind Spots With Words: Decentralized Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Language-Constrained Communication
abstract: arXiv:2611.29112v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) get increasingly used as collaborative partners across embodied robotics, AR/VR, and multi-user systems, spatial reasoning is now often distributed across agents with partial environment visibility, necessitating spatial reasoning integration. Prior work in language-mediated spatial integration is however strictly limited to simplified two-agent scenarios. To address this gap, we first formalize the general problem of decentralized multi-view spatial reasoning, where N agents observe distinct viewpoints, exchange budget-constrained natural language messages, and collaborate to enable a listener to answer spatial queries. We then introduce a novel multi-view spatial benchmark to isolate queries that demand non-trivial multi-view integration. translated_title: 用语言弥补盲区：通过语言受限通信实现去中心化多视角空间推理
translated_abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地被用作具身机器人、AR/VR和多用户系统中的协作伙伴，空间推理现在往往分布在仅具有部分环境可见性的多个智能体之间，因此需要空间推理的整合。然而，以往在语言介导的空间整合方面的研究严格局限于简化的双智能体场景。为了填补这一空白，我们首先形式化了去中心化多视角空间推理的一般问题，其中N个智能体从各自不同的视角进行观察，交换受预算限制的自然语言消息，并相互协作使监听者能够回答空间查询。随后，我们引入了一个新颖的多视角空间基准，以筛选出那些需要非平凡多视角整合的查询。通过广泛的实证研究，我们发现将去中心化空间推理限制在预算有限的自然语言通信下所产生的性能损失远小于……
tldr: 该论文首次形式化了去中心化多视角空间推理这一通用问题（N个智能体各自观察不同视角并通过受限自然语言消息协作），并提出了新的多视角空间基准，研究发现用预算受限的自然语言进行空间推理整合的代价远小于预期。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the general problem of decentralized multi-view spatial reasoning, where N agents with distinct viewpoints collaborate through budget-constrained natural language messages, introduces a novel multi-view spatial benchmark, and finds that the performance penalty of restricting spatial reasoning to limited-budget natural language communication is far smaller than expected.
